    S1 = sp.sinh(r_1)
    C2 = sp.cosh(r_2)
    S2 = sp.sinh(r_2)

    # of the amplification paths from the two OPAs.

    # A = sqrt(mu)*S1*C2 + C1*S2*cos(phi_2 - phi_1 - 2*theta)
    # The variance is V = 1 + 2*A^2 + ... (additional loss terms)

    # The operator I_theta is combination of signal and idler.

    # The term is 2*(sqrt(mu)*sinh(r1)*cosh(r2) - cosh(r1)*sinh(r2)*cos(phi2 - phi1))^2 + ...
